title: Echo sentence deck
description: An importable Echo deck. See DECK-FORMAT.md. Echo also accepts its own backup files, which carry more fields; a new deck needs only these.

description.description: What the deck covers and for whom.

language.description: Echo language code (see LANGUAGES in core.js).

id.description: Stable, unique, deck-prefixed ID, e.g. my-travel-deck-001. Keep it across versions of the deck.

sourceLang.description: Language of source. Omitted means en.

targetLang.description: Language being learned. Omitted means ja.

source.description: What the sentence means, in the learner's language.

target.description: One complete natural sentence in the target language. Japanese may carry readings as 漢字【かんじ】.

casualTarget.description: Japanese only: casual form. Defaults to target.

politeTarget.description: Japanese only: polite form. Defaults to target.

updatedAt.description: Set to a newer time to replace an already-imported sentence with the same id. Progress is kept.
